name: Default
shortDescription: MQTT 5.0 and 3.1.1 broker with a web dashboard, REST API, rule engine and data integrations, with MQTT over WebSocket served on the app domain.

alerts.message: Log in to the dashboard as admin with the generated EMQX_DASHBOARD__DEFAULT_PASSWORD. It only seeds the first admin; later changes are made in the dashboard. MQTT clients can connect anonymously until you add an authenticator under Access Control > Authentication.
Only MQTT over WebSocket is routed, at wss://<your domain>/mqtt. Plain MQTT (1883) and MQTT over TLS (8883) are TCP protocols and are not published by this template.
